records.text: Sathren Azuredawn is a general goods merchant in Silvermoon’s Bazaar and receives Quartermaster Lymel’s shipment paperwork. When the list reaches him, he reacts with disbelief at its length and asks whether anyone came along to help carry it.

A Silvermoon City guardian directs visitors to city services such as the auction house and bank. The guardian voices loyalty to the Blood Knights and the resolve of Silvermoon’s people, presenting the city’s defense as a duty to its people.

Vinemaster Suntouched is Silvermoon’s wine and spirits merchant. When approached while speaking with a lady, Vinemaster objects to the interruption, then turns to the customer and offers local and exotic drinks, emphasizing their quality.
Tandrine is Silvermoon’s Guild Master and registrar, welcoming visitors who want to form a guild or create its crest.

Kredis is a tabard vendor in Silvermoon City. His shop handles tabard replacements: customers who have lost certain earned tabards can ask for them by name, including Blood Knight, Hand, Protector, and Illidari trophy tabards.

Zalle is a reagent vendor in Silvermoon City. Lord Solanar identifies him as a source of Arcane Catalyst for the precise mixture needed in his work; Zalle's role is to supply reagents to the city's customers.

Velanni tends the alchemy supplies and reagents trade in Silvermoon City. Her shop serves alchemical customers seeking supplies, giving her a more specialized place in the city's merchant quarter than a general goods stall.
Parnis is a tradesman in Silvermoon City, serving customers from a general merchant's stall. His title marks a broad place in the city's trade rather than a named specialty.
Novia is a banker at the Royal Exchange Bank in Silvermoon City. Her greeting offers assistance to the bank's visitors, and her banking service gives customers access to their stored funds.
Periel is a banker at the Royal Exchange Bank in Silvermoon City. He shares the bank's courteous welcome to visitors and provides access to their stored funds as part of its service.
Daenice is a banker whose service is straightforward: visitors can ask to see their bank.
Innkeeper Velandra offers shelter amid the shattered lands and handles the usual inn services, including rooms and goods. She also responds to a seasonal trick-or-treat request.
Celana is a bowyer who sells archery supplies and can repair equipment, serving visitors who need ammunition or gear maintained.
Mathaleron is a gunsmith who sells ammunition and repairs equipment, serving visitors who need supplies or their gear maintained.
Ileda trains visitors in weapon use and can direct those seeking instruction from other weapon masters. She has little patience for visitors who are not there to train.
Zyandrel sells cloth armor and repairs equipment, offering practical help to visitors seeking clothing or gear maintenance.
Gelanthis is a jewelcrafting supplies vendor in the settlement. The available service lets visitors browse his goods; the records provide no further personal history or views.
Keeli is a mail armor merchant in the settlement, with vendor and repair services available. Visitors can browse goods; the records offer no further personal history or outlook.
Tynna is a plate armor merchant in the settlement, with vendor and repair services available. Visitors can browse goods; the records offer no further personal history or outlook.
Ithillan is an auctioneer in the settlement. His auction service is available to visitors; the records establish his occupation but provide no personal history or views.
Caidori is an auctioneer in the settlement. Her auction service is available to visitors; the records establish her occupation but provide no personal history or views.
Tandron is an auctioneer. His auction service is available to visitors.
Andra is a clothier who offers goods to browse and handles repairs. Her role joins the clothing trade with practical equipment upkeep, giving her shop a broader function than clothing sales alone.
Sedana is an enchanting trainer. Her greeting frames the craft as a set of mysteries to uncover, and she invites visitors to ask for training.
Dolothos is identified as an apprentice enchanter. His recorded greeting asks which enchantments interest the visitor, giving him a direct connection to the craft.
Lyna is the Enchanting Supplies vendor.
Zathanna is a wand vendor who also handles repairs. Her shop pairs a focused trade in magical implements with practical equipment upkeep.
Welethelon is a blunt weapon merchant who also handles repairs. His shop pairs a focused weapon trade with practical equipment upkeep.
Deynna is identified as a supplier of tailoring goods. Customers can browse her goods.
Galana is an apprentice tailor who offers to show customers a pattern or two. Her greeting points to patterns as the focus of her tailoring service.
Keelen Sheets is a tailoring trainer who presents Keelen's Trustworthy Tailoring as a shop for customers' needs. Keelen says customers can ask to train and offers to teach them.
Melaris is identified as a supplier of alchemy goods.
Camberon is an alchemy trainer who asks customers what formula interests them and offers training.
Razia is identified as an apprentice alchemist.
Botanist Nathera teaches herbalism.

Alamma is a warlock trainer who recognizes students' hunger for power and scorns untrained ears. Alamma respects Strahad's power despite his being human, referring ready pupils to him for greater summonings and to Menara Voidrender for further tests. Surprised that a pupil has resisted arcane corruption and madness, Alamma still urges pushing further. An unusual request from the imp Impsy is passed on with its demand for felcloth as a sign of good faith.

Talionia is a warlock trainer who pushes pupils beyond an imp to mastering a voidwalker and is impressed when they survive dangers that have killed other apprentices. Talionia respects Gan'rul Bloodeye's widely known knowledge and directs distant pupils back to him. When forced to summon a tardy pupil, Talionia is openly sarcastic and angry, threatening incineration and warning that the lesson will not be repeated.

Zanien is a warlock trainer who recognizes a desire for power and dismisses untrained visitors as lacking a spine. Zanien passes on the imp Impsy's unusual request for felcloth as a sign of good faith, assuming an experienced warlock knows the satyrs who carry it.

Torian recognizes an experienced warlock's growing mastery over otherworldly beings and suggests attempting to bind a dreadsteed. Torian warns that the summoning requires great power and resources and sends the warlock to Mor'zul Bloodbringer at the Altar of Storms, expressing confidence that such a pupil will not shy from danger.
Bithrus sells fireworks.

Zaedana is a mage trainer who offers help with studies but dismisses those judged unable to grasp the arcane. Zaedana refers pupils to the mage colleague Tabetha about a rumored grievance against a Zul'Farrak sand troll, warning them to bring friends if sent there.

Quithas is a mage trainer who sends helpers to Deino in Orgrimmar and directs experienced pupils toward Archmage Xylem in Azshara. Quithas explains that access to Xylem's cliff-top tower depends on Sanath Lim-yo's teleportation, describing the servant as arrogant.
Inethven is a mage trainer who offers help with studies but dismisses visitors judged unable to grasp the arcane.
Narinth teaches ready mages portal magic that can bring them back to the trainer's location. Narinth stresses the mental acuity needed to grasp portal magic and turns away those judged unready.

Harene Plainwalker teaches druids in the eyes of the Earth Mother and offers wishes for their ancestors' protection. Harene passes on Turak Runetotem's request for a pupil to train with him in Thunder Bluff, praising Turak as wise and patient.
Shalenn is a stable master who helps stable pets and assists in recovering lost companions.

Aldrae is a priest trainer who credits the Light with strength and magic and teaches that helping those in need matters more than the method used. Aldrae sends helpers to Ogtinc in Azshara to aid the Cenarion Circle.

Lotheolan is a priest trainer who credits the Light with strength and magic and teaches that helping those in need matters more than the method used. Lotheolan sends helpers to Ogtinc in Azshara to aid the Cenarion Circle.
Belestra is a priest trainer who credits the Light with the strength and magic to triumph, and sometimes directs visitors elsewhere when there is no time for a sermon.

Alestus is a First Aid trainer. He points learners toward Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen in Theramore for further training and mentions Deneb Walker in Stromgarde as having a book to improve First Aid techniques.
Belil is a mining trainer who offers instruction in the trade.
Zelan is a supplier of mining goods, with a shop for browsing mining supplies.
Feledis sells axes and provides repair service.
Danwe is an engineering trainer. He offers to teach what he knows and urges the learner to keep up, giving his instruction a brisk, businesslike edge.
Gloresse is identified as an apprentice engineer.

Bemarrin is a Silvermoon blacksmithing trainer who helps prepare a weapon for a Blood Knight earning the rank of adept. He notes that few who enter the order’s training return to him with the materials, and sends the finished weapon on to serve Silvermoon and the order.
Eriden supplies blacksmithing goods in Silvermoon and offers repairs. His role centers on keeping smiths equipped and their gear serviceable.
Mirvedon is an apprentice blacksmith.
Tana is a Silvermoon hunter trainer. She teaches the hunter’s craft and has training-related exchanges for hunters, including an exchange that addresses a fellow ranger.
Oninath is a Silvermoon hunter trainer who teaches the hunter’s craft. His training conversations include an exchange addressing a fellow ranger.
Zandine is a Silvermoon hunter trainer who teaches the hunter’s craft. She greets fellow rangers.

Halthenis trains hunters to care for and train their pets in Silvermoon. He is known for treating respectful students with respect in return. He frames their skills as service to the city and its greater cause, describing disemboweling an enemy as one of the pet's “interesting tricks.”

Sylann is a cooking trainer who shares the student's passion for cooking and offers to teach it. For further improvement, Sylann points students toward Dirge Quikcleave, a master of the culinary arts in Gadgetzan.
Quelis supplies cooking goods.
Osselan is a paladin trainer who offers instruction in the ways of the Light and further training in the naaru's power. He may challenge a student's resolve.
Ithelis is a paladin trainer who offers instruction in the ways of the Light and further training in the naaru's power. He may challenge a student's resolve.

Champion Bachi trains paladins in the ways of the Light, with options for further training, talent changes, and dual specialization. His stern greeting challenges a visitor’s resolve, reflecting the demanding path he teaches.
Darlia is a poison-supplies merchant on Murder Row, near the rogue trainers in Silvermoon. Her goods include the crepuscular powder sought for Lord Solanar Bloodwrath’s reagent mixture.

Zelanis trains rogues and coordinates intelligence work for the blood elves. He sends an agent to retrieve reports from Keltus Darkleaf, a trusted spy who often acts independently, and directs another urgent inquiry to his associate Eralan in Tranquillien. His guarded greeting hints at the secrecy surrounding his work.
Elara trains rogues and asks visitors whether they were followed.
Nerisen trains rogues and asks visitors whether they were followed.
Talmar is identified as an apprentice leatherworker.
Lynalis trains leatherworkers. Her greeting briskly urges visitors to prepare their leather properly before she shows them how to make serviceable items.
Zaralda sells leatherworking supplies.
Rathin is a bag vendor.
Noraelath is a leather armor merchant in the Outland settlement. Her native services let visitors browse goods, including through the merchant and vendor options.
Tyn is a skinning trainer in the Outland settlement. The training option presents instruction in skinning, and visitors can choose “Train me” from the gossip menu.
Winthren is a shield merchant in the Outland settlement. His native services let visitors browse goods through the merchant and vendor options.

Karen Wentworth is an Arathi Basin battlemaster. Her conditional dialogue frames the struggle as free-willed undead fighting the League of Arathor, and calls for aid to the Defilers against humans and their Alliance allies.

Gurak is an Alterac Valley battlemaster. His dialogue addresses a visitor who lacks the experience to survive there and separately asks whether they are ready to fight the Stormpike Guard; these are conditional lines, not universal outcomes.
Krukk is a Warsong Gulch battlemaster. His conditional dialogue welcomes heroes to a battleground in need of them, while another line tells an insufficiently seasoned visitor they cannot yet enter.
Amin is an apprentice jewelcrafter who invites questions about the profession.
Drathen is a fishing trainer whose advice points skilled anglers to Old Man Heming's copy of The Bass and You and to Nat Pagle in Dustwallow Marsh.
Yatheon sells engineering supplies.
Grand Magister Rommath bears the title of Grand Magister.
Halduron Brightwing bears the title of Ranger General.

Lor’themar Theron is Regent Lord of Quel’Thalas. He seeks equal standing for the sin’dorei within the Horde, with Sylvanas as an ally. His diplomacy treats their connection to Outland as an opportunity for Thrall, while acknowledging that this account is not the whole truth. He urges his people to endure upheaval as they endured Arthas’s invasion, and condemns Kael’thas’s betrayal.
Jenath is an auctioneer in Silvermoon City and handles the Auction service there.
Vynna is an auctioneer in Silvermoon City and handles the Auction service there.
Feynna is an auctioneer in Silvermoon City and handles the Auction service there.
Innkeeper Jovia tends an inn amid Outland's shattered lands, offering shelter, goods, and a place to make a home. Her welcome also includes a seasonal Trick or Treat interaction.
Ceera is a banker at the Bank of Silvermoon. She welcomes visitors and offers access to the depository, handling the everyday business of the bank.
Elana is a banker at the Bank of Silvermoon. She welcomes visitors and offers access to the depository, handling the everyday business of the bank.
Hatheon is a banker in Silvermoon. He can show customers their bank, tending to the practical work of the city's financial services.

Knight-Lord Bloodvalor teaches the Blood Knights at their Silvermoon headquarters, where he presents the order as defenders of Quel’Thalas and servants of Silvermoon. His instruction joins discipline in wielding the Light to harsh tests of readiness: he admits sending Sangrias Stillblade to kill an initiate as a deliberate lesson in vigilance, and treats the loss of life as part of training. Bloodvalor also directs the initiate’s path through the order, including the effort to restore Stillblade and the resources and insignia expected of a new adept. He urges loyalty to the order and continued training.

Magister Astalor Bloodsworn is a Blood Knight magister in Silvermoon who explains the order’s dependence on the captive naaru: its power underpins their mastery of the Light, and the Blood Knights devised a way to claim that power. After Kael’thas’s betrayal and the loss of the order’s source of power, Astalor directs an initiate to learn new methods and describes drawing residual Light from magisters who once tended the naaru. He says their care is arranged and that Lady Liadrin seeks another source of power for the order.

Blood Knight Stillblade has little enthusiasm for volunteering when Bloodvalor needs someone. After his resurrection, he complains of a pounding head, says he will not perform that duty again, and jokes that wine might help.
Blood Knight Adepts give terse warnings to move along or stay away, projecting a guarded presence in Silvermoon.
A Blood Elf Magister in Silvermoon City.
Silvermoon's Arcane Guardians issue civic directives and demand obedience and mandatory happiness. Their public messaging awkwardly invokes Kael'thas before correcting itself to Lor'themar.

Champion Vranesh regards a ranger practice ground with a condescending smirk, gives the guards a disapproving scowl, and inclines his head slightly to two guardians. His gestures suggest disdain for the guards and a superior air toward the rangers, tempered by a courteous greeting to the guardians.
A Silvermoon Ranger, one of several stationed in this area.

Initiate Colin worries about the Sun King's fall and the loss that leaves the Blood Knights needing another source. He puts his hope in Lady Liadrin finding a way forward, while uncertainty about the future and the whispers of others leave him resentful and uneasy.

Initiate Emeline is shaken by a loss she describes as betrayal and worries because the chamber below is empty. She also resents the rangers outside and the neighbors who look down on her, openly mocking their haughty attitudes.
Cheneta is identified as a Horde Emissary.
Tatai is identified as a Horde Emissary.
Dela Runetotem is identified as a Horde Emissary.
Kristine Denny is a Horde emissary, a named representative associated with the Horde.
Ambassador Kelemar bears an ambassador's title, though whom or what he represents is not established.

Trayanise is chasing a small arcane construct after crystals failed to work as expected. He worries the magister will kill him and threatens to disenchant the construct's components when he catches it. He also warns others to stay out of the regent lord's way. His words convey anxious frustration with the runaway creation and its faulty crystals.
Keyanomir, a humanoid in Silvermoon City.
Nimrida is identified as Keyanomir's minion, linking her to him in a subordinate role.
Tiny Arcane Construct is the small creation Trayanise pursues after crystals fail to work as expected. Trayanise calls for it to return and threatens to disenchant its components if he catches it.

Lyria Skystrider addresses her people about their survival and condemns the new alliance as a betrayal of former allies. She doubts that the Dark Lady is truly Sylvanas, blames the magisters for endangering them, and questions whether the orcs will stand by them.
A Silvermoon magister associated with Ritual of Summoning.
Olirea is a fishing-supplies vendor who offers goods for browsing.
A humanoid bearing the designation Silvermoon Farstrider.
Conjurer Tyren is a humanoid in Silvermoon City.
Trainee Alcor is identified as a trainee.
Trainee Firea is identified as a trainee.
Instructor Cel is identified as an instructor.

Vaeron Kormar argues that the blood elves were betrayed and calls his own people the only ones they can trust. He says the Ranger-General of Silvermoon will be a loyal ally, and rejects being called a traitor.

Terric Brightwind challenges calls to trust the dwarves, asking when they have ever been friends to the blood elves. He also dismisses advocacy for a renewed alliance as idealistic and defends the blood elves' need for magic.

Priest Ennas warns that dependence on magic and the blight threaten the blood elves' future, and urges residents to speak up before their people destroy what they have built. He also praises Lor'themar's remaking of Silvermoon and says the magisters can guide a prosperous future, even as he calls for reconsidering the current course.
A leper gnome laborer in Silvermoon, one of several placed in the city.

Melaya Tassier remembers the humans' assault on blood elf lands as abandonment in her people's darkest hour, and blames the human prince for leading it. She points to Silvermoon's wonders as proof of magic's value and rejects the idea that her people should live like savages.
Rarthein, a humanoid in Silvermoon City.
Sirigna'no is identified as Keelen Sheets's minion.
A humanoid known as Elrodan.
Aurosalia is a named speaker who interrupts with “Stop! Will you stop—” in a brief attempt to halt someone.

Darise is an auctioneer, offering access to the auction for those seeking to trade. Her work connects buyers and sellers through the market, giving her a practical role in the local exchange of goods.
A Blood Elf warlock.
Faenel the Drunkard is in Silvermoon City.
Gatewatcher Aendor is a gatewatcher whose terse warnings tell people to move along and say their business does not concern them, giving the named sentinel a guarded, dismissive manner.

The Harassed Citizen is wary of conversation and asks to be left alone, fearing further trouble with an unnamed group. Their words point to pressure they have already faced, without identifying who caused it or what happened.
A blood elf among the commoners found across several regions, with seasonal small talk about Midsummer and Lunar Festival, respect for elders, Forsaken allies, and a playful tentacle-face taunt.
Kalinda is a jewelcrafting trainer who offers to share her knowledge.

Bipp Glizzitor is the Arena Battlemaster associated with the Steamwheedle Fighting Circuit. His responses challenge a fighter's ability or entertain the possibility of competing, giving him a brusque, testing manner.
Worker Mo'rrisroe is associated with the Silvermoon Builders Association, linking this worker to the city's building work.

Duyash the Cruel serves as the Eye of the Storm battlemaster. He presents the contest as a Horde assault against the Alliance and draenei, who he says are seeking control of Outland's mana cells, and invites the player to join. His battleground invitation is a service role; the dialogue also gives him a clear Horde perspective on the conflict.

Sorim Lightsong is the Horde cloth quartermaster in Silvermoon. He speaks of the city's cloth drive, asks about donations, and explains that contributing is meant to raise the donor's standing with Silvermoon. One donation message says runecloth is especially scarce, while his thanks for wool and silk donations convey appreciation for the contributions.
The Royal Guard are Silvermoon's defenders. These sturdy guards keep watch in the city, serving as a visible protective presence among its people.
Herald Amorlin passes along calls for aid that send heroes to seek out others: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache or High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark.
Officer Dawning serves Silvermoon City in a commendations role.
A Silvermoon Citizen is one of the city's residents.
A Veteran Gladiator is a seasoned combatant. The title signals experience in gladiatorial fighting.
A Grizzled Gladiator is a weathered, experienced fighter. The title suggests long familiarity with gladiatorial combat.
Loirea Galerunner is identified as a Lunar Festival herald, giving her a public role in the celebration.

Michael Schweitzer manages the Tauren Chieftains and arranges their tours. In Silvermoon, he describes the musicians practicing or relaxing on the balcony and welcomes admirers to wave, saying the band enjoys the attention.

Bergrisst is a member of the Tauren Chieftains in Silvermoon. Manager Michael Schweitzer arranges the band’s tours and describes its members practicing or relaxing on the balcony, where they welcome admirers’ attention.

Chief Thunder-Skins is a member of the Tauren Chieftains in Silvermoon. Manager Michael Schweitzer arranges the band’s tours and describes its members practicing or relaxing on the balcony, where they welcome admirers’ attention.

Mai’Kyl is a member of the Tauren Chieftains in Silvermoon. Manager Michael Schweitzer arranges the band’s tours and describes its members practicing or relaxing on the balcony, where they welcome admirers’ attention.
Samuro is a member of the Tauren Chieftains in Silvermoon. Michael Schweitzer manages the band’s tours and describes its members practicing or relaxing on the balcony, welcoming admirers’ attention.

Sig Nicious is a member of the Tauren Chieftains in Silvermoon. Michael Schweitzer manages the band’s tours and describes its members practicing or relaxing on the balcony, welcoming admirers’ attention.

Steven Thomas is an old friend of Schweitzer's, and their reunion in Shattrath reminded him how much friendship matters. He says Schweitzer spends less time in Tirisfal these days, so he brought the Orb of Translocation to Shattrath to greet him.

Arcanist Myndimendez is a fan of the Tauren Chieftains. Myndimendez praises their show in Terokkar Forest, calls them Azeroth's best-known minstrels, and hopes they will perform in Silvermoon. The arcanist would dearly like a chance to meet them.
Roitau oversees the workers who support the Tauren Chieftains' show. The crew handles packing and transporting the wagons, building and dismantling the stage, and setting up the pyrotechnics.

Lord Solanar Bloodwrath is a Blood Knight who speaks of defending Quel'Thalas and preserving the order. He describes the masters as an elite inner circle chosen for dedication, skill, and trustworthiness, and says candidates need a sponsor and must prove their commitment. His teaching stresses that loyalty includes supplying the order as well as fighting; he praises dedication and prowess as marks of mastery.
A Midsummer merchant offering festival goods for visitors to browse.

Mabrian Fardawn serves as the Strand of the Ancients battlemaster, focused on that battleground. His greeting tells those who are not yet strong enough to gain more experience before trying to fight there.
Zantasia is an inscription trainer.
Lelorian is an inscription-supplies vendor, with a straightforward role: providing goods for inscription work. Customers can browse the wares.

Bruka Woebringer serves as the Isle of Conquest battlemaster, focused on that battleground. His greeting tells those who are not yet strong enough to gain more experience before trying to fight there.

Magistrix Caradess is a Wintergrasp battle-mage who handles the battleground queue. Her greeting discusses joining the battle and supporting forces there, placing her at the point where would-be fighters seek entry.
A Shaker in Silvermoon City.
A small Shaker in Silvermoon City.

Kwee Q. Peddlefeet is an official Crown event mascot for the Charitable Charms program. He explains how Lovely Charms can become bracelets for friends, loved ones, or favored leaders, and offers a Lovely Charm Collector’s Kit.

Kieupid is a pet trainer who guides hunters in training their pets and offers help with untraining. He makes clear that his instruction is for hunters and their companions, welcoming them with a friendly greeting.

place_records.text: You are in Silvermoon City, Horde land in the Eastern Kingdoms. Its Bazaar has general goods merchant Sathren Azuredawn, and its trainers teach warlock, mage, druid, priest and blacksmithing skills, among them Alamma and Zaedana. Its inn, bank and auction house serve the Horde folk who fill the city.
